cases.clinical_reasoning: Benign Keratosis / Seborrheic Keratosis (Dr. Abhishek Primary Bug Audit Case): Non-melanocytic epidermal proliferative lesion. Hallmarks include multiple milia-like cysts (star-like bright white-yellow globules), dark brown comedo-like openings, sharply demarcated 'stuck-on' borders, and cerebriform crypts/fissures. Hairpin vessels with prominent white halos may be observed. CRITICAL AUDIT SAFEGUARD: Brown reticular ridges mimic a pigment network, but are anatomical pseudonetworks around follicular openings; pink/erythematous background is normal inflammatory blush, NOT polymorphous vessels. As a non-melanocytic lesion, the Two-Step Algorithm mandates that 7-Point Checklist scoring must be BYPASSED to avoid false-positive melanoma flags.
